body:
Join NordicNeuroLab and help ensure the quality of innovative medical technology used by hospitals and research institutions worldwide.

 

Headquartered in Bergen, Norway, NordicNeuroLab is an international and growing company with ambitious plans. We are now looking for a detail-oriented and structured QA Technician to strengthen their team.

 

## About the Role

As a QA Technician, you will play a key role in ensuring that materials, components, and products meet established quality requirements before they reach NordicNeuroLabs’ customers. You will work closely with Production, Engineering, and Quality functions to maintain high standards of quality, traceability, and compliance.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with documentation, inspections, quality control activities, and continuous improvement in a production environment.

 

## Key Responsibilities

• Perform incoming inspections of components, assemblies, and materials.
• Conduct visual and mechanical inspections of PCBAs, electronic components, optical parts, and mechanical parts.
• Perform functional testing of products and assemblies according to established procedures prior to release.
• Review production documentation and Device Production Records (DPRs) to ensure accuracy and traceability.
• Identify, document, and follow up quality deviations and non-conformances (NCRs).
• Support root cause investigations and corrective actions in production related areas.
• Ensure manufacturing and inspection activities are performed according to approved procedures.
• Support calibration and maintenance activities for production and test equipment.
• Assist with environmental monitoring activities where applicable.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of quality processes and documentation.
• Work closely with Production and Quality teams to maintain compliance and product quality.

 

## Qualifications

## Required

• Technical education, vocational training, or relevant practical experience.
• Experience working in a manufacturing, production, QA, or QC environment.
• Experience performing inspections, quality checks, or documentation review.
• Ability to read and follow procedures, specifications, and technical documentation.
• Strong attention to detail and a structured way of working.
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

 

## Preferred

• Experience as a QA Technician, QC Technician, Quality Inspector, or similar role.
• Experience from regulated industries such as Medical Devices, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, Aerospace, Automotive, or related sectors.
• Experience with ERP, eQMS, or other quality management systems.
• Knowledge of NCR handling, traceability requirements, and quality documentation.
• Experience inspecting electronic products, PCBAs, or technical assemblies. 
• Familiarity with IPC-A-610 standards.
• Experience using inspection and measurement tools such as calipers, micrometers, multimeters, oscilloscopes and spectrum analyzer or microscopes.

 

## Who We Are Looking For

## We believe the right person for this role:

• Has exceptional attention to detail.
• Is highly organized and structured.
• Enjoys working with documentation and quality processes.
• Has the confidence to challenge deviations from procedures when necessary.
• Takes pride in accuracy and quality.
• Is proactive, dependable, and solution oriented.
• Thrives in an environment where quality and compliance are essential.

 

## Why Join NordicNeuroLab?

• Work with innovative medical technology products used worldwide.
• Join an international company with ambitious growth plans.
• Be part of a collaborative environment where engineering, quality, and innovation work closely together.
• Help shape a newly established role with significant influence and development opportunities. · Work alongside experienced specialists in Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Engineering.
• Contribute directly to patient-focused technology that makes a difference globally.

 

For questions regarding this position, please contact Michelle Kolskår, Head of Sales at Folk AS.
Phone: +47 48 13 66 56
E-mail: michelle@folkas.com

 

Since its establishment in 2004, Folk AS has assisted both Norwegian and international companies in finding highly skilled professionals within technical and administrative disciplines for project-based, temporary, and permanent positions. This is what we do best, and where our expertise lies.

Our core values are: ethical, personal, committed, and flexible.

 

## We see opportunities in your competence!
employerInfo: NordicNeuroLab AS (NNL) develops and manufactures advanced solutions for functional MRI (fMRI) studies and patient comfort systems used in MRI environments worldwide. Their products are trusted by hospitals, universities, and research institutions across the globe and play an important role in supporting the diagnosis and treatment of neurological disorders.
